propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its only reader classify_probe_response, but the keys still validate and should be deprecated rather than removed immediately.

Both resolved_statuses keys were live and operator-documented in shipped release v0.10.1 via adapters/jira/probe.py::_resolve_resolved_statuses, making hard removal a genuine upgrade hazard without operator sign-off.

The write-only DataCenter transport plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses param, _resolved_statuses attribute, JiraDataCenterSettings.resolved_statuses, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES) must be removed because nothing reads the stored value.
Both config keys must emit registered deprecation warnings naming removal release v1.0.0, continue to validate unchanged, and be documented as deprecated in docs/config.md and docs/user-guide.md.
The config-read gate markers pointing at resolved_statuses must be repointed to follow-up ticket f408-64ad-ee41-46b6, which will handle hard removal via tombstones pending operator sign-off.
